newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Port conditions update - Australia - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Port conditions update - Australia - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

AUSTRALIA, July 11 - Newcastle - Coal miners at Coal and Allied's No.1 Hunter Valley mine are still on strike. Talks requested by the arbitration commission between both parties have again broken down.

QUEENSLAND - Coal mine at the Blair Athol coal mine owned by CSR commenced strike action on July 10 over a disciplinary matter. The mine was working albeit with reduced productivity and railings to Dalrymple Bay coal terminal continue. The mine presently has a large stockpile of coal at the port terminal.
